templates.example: McDonalds 🛍 Paid $55.70 at McDonalds Spent today: $55.70

when.text: McDonalds 🛍 Paid $55.70 at McDonalds Spent today: $55.70

messageRow.text: McDonalds 🛍 Paid $55.70 at McDonalds Spent today: $55.70

notes: Merchant McDonalds is listed in category Restaurants, so a spending is created. Both messages are handled in the same test; the message list has 2 rows and the spending list 1 row (android/legacy/src/androidTest/java/com/mas/mobile/SmsMessageCaptureTest.kt). Messages are passed straight to handleRawMessage, not through SmsListener.
